requirements.rule: A Web3 infrastructure DEMO simulating an ordinary commodity spot intermediary, with cryptocurrency and commodity-market presentation; do not claim to operate a licensed centralized exchange or real financial service.
One NFT equals one whole warehouse receipt; no fractions.

Allow continuous A to B to C to D trading while registration catches up. Ordinary transfers cannot require holder equal to owner, a closed projection gap or current finality; the holder-equals-owner remint predicate is separate.
Support 8415Wallet V3 or any wallet satisfying the same authorization and control semantics; no exclusive wallet binding.
Every Agent operation comes from verifiable bounded human wallet authority.
The buyer pays its transaction gas and assigned rollback gas in ETH only. Warn and refuse a new trade when ETH is absent or insufficient. Agent service fees remain a separate later decision.

No arbitrary compulsory custody or instant liquidation. Normal conditional funds escrow and agreed asset-return control remain. Only the explicitly consented deferred-mode debt and recovery-gas liquidation in section 7.1 is added.
Transfer the mapped bill of lading only; physical collection belongs to the parties named in its terms.
The off-chain change voucher is itself the registration receipt; Oracle alone ingests, verifies and records it on chain.
Align ArtFi whole artwork and EX backend; direct, electronic and intermediary registration are transaction sources with middleware and frontend paths.

For prepaid mode: NFT0 fixes one or more allowed price currencies at mint. Each order explicitly selects one member; insufficient selected-currency funds warn and refuse. EX does not exchange, auto-select, combine currency balances or substitute assets for principal or ETH gas. Holder remint creates a new NFT and never edits the old allowed set. For explicitly selected deferred mode, section 7.1 substitutes verified reserved collateral allowance for principal prefunding, not for gas or currency identity.

A holder possessing the original NFT may atomically burn it and mint a replacement under the remint conditions. New terms may be added, removed or changed before the new mint; retain bidirectional identity and complete history.
Demonstrate hedging, collateral and arbitrage scenarios involving BTC/ETH and whole soybean/iron-ore receipts; labels do not authorize financing, futures or guaranteed returns.

Both cryptocurrency and commodity warehouse-receipt NFTs are confirmed collateral choices; do not restrict the scenario to crypto collateral only. Deferred crypto-collateral terms are specified in section 7.1; other economic and execution parameters remain D-14.

Continuously read and refresh real public commodity spot reference prices with traceable source values/times and fetch times. NFT quotes/trades may be simulated but must not impersonate external references.
Market makers may submit ordinary quotes under the same currency, price-priority, FIFO and authorization rules; no privileged priority, AMM, incentives or return promise is implied.

EX frontend covers markets, NFTs, trades and evidence. Exclude wallet asset overview, account, security, validator and Agent-permission-management pages while retaining transaction authorization and balance/fee checks.

Align six UI languages with 8415wallet.com. Source candidates are en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, fr, es and ja; verify live alignment separately. Cover every new state/error/explanation and preserve protocol identifiers.

Record full receipt, underlying commodity name, applicable specification/grade, quantity/unit, receipt/bill number, issuer, registrar/source, location, supporting records and bill terms; trade exactly one NFT.
Record asset-appropriate specification/template/version, required fields and nonsecret original-document mapping; no invented legal effect or institutional endorsement.
Receipt-access secrets remain encrypted in controlled off-chain storage; NFT holds opaque nonsecret mappings. Never hold user wallet private keys.
Declare trade and registration deadlines at mint, including unit, timezone, precision and comparison/serialization semantics; no silent later change.
Declare voucher format, required fields and source path at mint; Oracle verifies it as the one business receipt.
Retain collection terms for inspection without EX physical collection, transport or warehouse-exit work. Authorized holder remint is separate from retired collection-driven burn.

At mint NFT0 records one or more allowed price currencies with verifiable asset, network and smallest-unit mappings. No caller or administrator can edit the existing NFT currency set after mint. A valid remint may set new terms, which become immutable on the new NFT.

A holder possessing the original NFT with holder equal to owner may remint under the existing wallet/contract authorization. This predicate represents no unfinished trades under the confirmed mechanism; add no clearing, refund, unfreeze, migration or extra approval prerequisite.
Burning the old NFT and validly minting the replacement are one atomic consistency operation. No outcome may destroy the sole valid asset or leave both tokens valid for the same bill of lading.
Before replacement mint the holder may add, remove or change the new terms, including allowed currencies. Preserve old terms and explicit differences; freeze the new NFT currency set after mint.
Make old/new NFT links readable in both directions. A burned predecessor cannot trade or remint again. Preserve original registration, trade and funds evidence without rewriting or deletion.

Immediately before execution atomically recheck possession and holder equal to owner against original authority. Serialize competing trade/registration/remint; duplicate, failed or UNKNOWN outcomes reconcile the same operation before further decisions, never repeating burn, mint or debit blindly.
Only one valid ordered transfer head per receipt.
Reject partial quantities and duplicate valid asset mappings.
Finalized registration/settlement prefix moves forward only and survives suffix failure.
Release and refund exclude each other; exactly-once funds actions.
Only authorized Oracle chain records bound to correct asset, transfer, sequence, chain, registrar and journal advance business state.
Reject missing, expired, revoked or replayed authority.
Rollback affects only eligible unfinalized suffix and resumes after interruption.

The recorded owner may resell before holder catches up. Neither holder-owner equality, gap closure nor current finality is a prerequisite to an ordinary continuous transfer. Remint uses its separate possession and holder-equals-owner predicate.
Missing local registration observation is not rejection or immediate liquidation authority.
Record business finality separately from chain observation; reorg or duplicate events never create a second funds action.
Holder changes with the same Oracle registration record, never as a separate asynchronous business fact or second receipt.
Matching respects price priority, equal-price FIFO and best executable price; eligibility cannot grant queue priority.

In prepaid mode fully freeze each buyer's selected NFT0-allowed principal and confirmed maximum ETH gas separately before trading. Deferred mode instead requires the section 7.1 verified collateral allowance for principal; it still requires separate new-trade gas. Never double-use principal, collateral capacity or a confirmed freeze.

At the authoritative registered buyer cut, permanently remove that segment's NFT rollback control without waiting for the suffix. Release its prepaid funds; in deferred mode retain B's separate payment obligation until actual settlement, without reviving the completed NFT rollback.

Keep seller, buyer, price, asset, registration sequence, principal, fees and rollback per segment. Prepaid mode cannot use later-funds subsidy. Explicit deferred mode may allocate B's resale proceeds to its escrow under section 7.1, preserving refundable suffix obligations and preventing double allocation.
Bind release to genuine authorized Oracle chain source, asset, transfer and journal; historical registration and current holder observations remain distinguishable.

Prepaid mode releases already frozen principal without a second buyer payment. Deferred mode permits the explicitly agreed later payment, top-up and deadline liquidation in section 7.1. Technical recovery never duplicates debit, payment, release or gas.
Record both deadlines at mint; stop new trading at the declared cutoff.
Registration beyond trading cutoff fails the unregistered suffix and returns owner to effective holder; registration must also satisfy its own mint deadline.
Use mint rules and authoritative Oracle ordering for deadline decisions; protect registered/settled prefix; no late-voucher grace or second-receipt wait.
EX completion is bill-of-lading transfer with full terms and Oracle-confirmed holder, without physical collection.
Off-chain parties handle collection, transport and warehouse exit; these are not EX completion/acceptance conditions.

Do not introduce physical-collection-driven burn. Authorized holder remint atomically burns the old NFT; retain old/new receipt, registration, trade and funds history and prevent duplicate valid asset mappings.

Quote, freeze, release and refund each leg in the one currency explicitly selected from its immutable NFT0 allowed set. Keep principal and ETH gas accounts separate; no conversion, substitution or summed multi-currency payment. ETH-priced principal and gas cannot consume the same funds twice.

For prepaid mode: If available selected-currency funds cannot fully freeze the price, warn and stop before signing, execution and broadcast. Adequate ETH gas or other allowed currencies cannot replace this order principal. For explicitly selected deferred mode, section 7.1 substitutes verified reserved collateral allowance for principal prefunding, not for gas or currency identity.

For prepaid mode: One or more allowed currencies are immutable per minted NFT and each order binds one through its whole principal lifecycle. Principal or ETH gas shortage forms no new trade. No currency conversion, aggregate currency payment or third-party subsidy bypass; old and replacement identities remain distinct. For explicitly selected deferred mode, section 7.1 substitutes verified reserved collateral allowance for principal prefunding, not for gas or currency identity.
Remint never leaves both old and new valid or loses the valid asset through a one-sided burn. Existing history, funds and registration obligations survive the replacement.
If registration of B is refused while holder remains A, withdraw all unregistered segments and return owner to A without changing holder.
After AB registration, if registration of C is refused, withdraw only the unregistered suffix and return owner to B; preserve holder and settled prefix.

Refund each segment to its original buyer in its original selected NFT0-allowed price currency. Display original principal, actual ETH gas and net receipts separately by currency; never subtract ETH wei from non-ETH principal through a display exchange rate.

Rollback does not require the NFT to visit intermediate ordinary wallets or their current unfrozen ETH. Sufficient original ETH prepayment for the approved obligation remains usable, without a second prepayment, premature unfreeze or cancellation of rollback.
Rollback does not burn the NFT; valid unexpired authorized assets may start a new chain from recovered owner equal to effective holder.
Each leg buyer pays the actual gas assigned to its trade, refund and NFT return in ETH, without shifting liability merely because another party refused registration.
Do not charge one shared actual operation in full to multiple segments; allocation method remains D-04.

ETH is the sole gas settlement asset. Refuse a new trade if ETH is absent or insufficient after reservations; principal and gas balances cannot substitute for one another. Deferred-mode rollback may liquidate the borrower's collateral to cover a verified recovery-gas shortfall, without waiving the original new-trade gate or inventing a custody/redemption deadline.

Before trading disclose both the maximum gas amount and median estimate in ETH and contemporaneous ETH/USD display values for buyer confirmation. USD is display only. An estimate disclaimer does not replace numeric amounts.
Confirmed cap constrains the approved action scope together with the wallet grant; stop and obtain a new confirmation before exceeding it; no invented percentage or unlimited authority.
Use real applicable verifiable median samples with algorithm, population, count, window, observation time, network, action and source; no fabricated sample, fake zero or single prediction as P50.

Freeze the buyer-confirmed maximum in ETH separately from selected-currency principal before sending. Count available ETH and disjoint effective original approved prepayment only; never reuse other reservations or principal. Insufficient or incomplete freezing prevents send.
Debit verifiable actual ETH gas and unfreeze only unused ETH prepayment. Failed transactions still pay consumed gas. Duplicate events and retries cannot charge or unfreeze twice.

ETH is the sole gas settlement asset. USD is disclosure only; PYUSD, WETH or other assets cannot pay gas. No automatic exchange, non-ETH-principal gas deduction or platform/third-party subsidy bypass.
Zero ETH warns and refuses new trading before signing, execution and broadcast. Available ETH below the confirmed maximum freeze also refuses. UI, API, Agent and retry paths cannot bypass this check.
Trace each Agent action to valid human wallet authority.
Check asset, action, eligibility constraints, principal/fee bounds, expiry, nonce and chain domain without modifying signed terms or using counterparty restrictions as priority.
Support the actual semantic wallet contract; at least one genuine integrated path plus the same conformance checks for alternatives.
Revocation or expiry rejects new restricted actions with deterministic concurrent behavior.
Wallet manages Agent authorization; no extra platform approval layer or repeated manual step for an already permitted action.

Both orders must select the same member of the NFT0 mint-time allowed set. Price priority, FIFO and best executable price operate within one currency book only. No named-counterparty priority jump, FX conversion or numeric price ranking across currencies.

Reference CME spot matching and asset-specific receipt specifications only; do not import futures margin, CCP, leverage liquidation, proprietary trading or business fees. Market makers participate under the same ordinary order rules without AMM, incentives or preferential queueing.
Matching is not registration or settlement completion.

Continuously read real public spot references and refresh the frontend when new source records are read. Timestamp successful and failed fetches; a screenshot, hand-entered price or static design is not a live feed.

Retain provider/source, sourceAsOf, fetchedAt, currency, unit, specification/grade, market/location, priceType, sourceDelay and freshness. Preserve date-only source precision rather than inventing seconds.

Stale source, failed network/parse, conflicting units/specifications or absent data yields stale/unavailable/unknown and last-success time; retain identifiable old values without fake zero or false live labels. Record configured thresholds against actual supply cadence, not an invented SLA.
Keep references and simulated NFT quotes/trades distinct in data types, labels, timestamps and rendering. Never silently substitute futures, FX conversions, wet/dry tonnes, grades or markets.

Every NFT quote has its own status and correct keyboard/click detail route with preserved return context. A verified open gap displays literal openGapOF=YES in red; verified absence displays openGapOF=NO in green. Unknown/loading/error/unsupported never becomes NO or green.

Display independent currentPosition, ownerPosition and holderPosition from real records; distinguish ownerOf address, registration version and transfer position. Bind each signature to its role, position/transfer, original payload, applicable version/domain/nonce or equivalent and verification result. Unknown remains unknown; alignment/admission cannot imply signing.

Frontend ownership/signature views show positions and statuses only, never wallet names, full/truncated addresses, hover/title/accessible identity labels or recoverable identity displays. Backend authority bindings remain intact.

Display every applicable business condition completely as an identity-excluding projection of signed terms. Do not summarize or alter obligations or directly render identity-bearing raw documents/JSON/metadata. Keep original signed files complete, private and unchanged for hash/signature verification. The projection is not byte-identical to the original; translations are informative, placeholders cannot pass completeness.

An open gap, owner different from holder or current non-finality cannot automatically prohibit ordinary transfers. Existing deadline, funds and authority rules still apply; remint equality is evaluated separately.
Do not build wallet assets, account, security, validator or Agent-permission-management pages. Retain necessary EX eligibility/fee disclosure without disclosing wallet identities.

Align with 8415wallet.com's six languages; current source candidates are English en, Simplified Chinese zh-Hans, Traditional Chinese zh-Hant, French fr, Spanish es and Japanese ja. Verify live behavior separately through safe access, never by bypassing a certificate warning.

Reviewed fixed resources cover every market, NFT, gap explanation, terms heading, position/signature, missing-data, principal/gas, pending/failure/recovery message. No runtime automatic-translation dependency; verify key completeness, locale formatting and desktop/mobile layout without mixing or clipping.

Preserve openGapOF=YES/NO exact spelling and YES/red NO/green across locales, along with NFT0, verified ownerOf/currentEntry/holderAsOf/openGapOf names and all chain/asset/transaction/protocol identifiers. Original signed terms retain language/version; explanations are informative and cannot change amounts, order, identity or status.

CI and its applicable automated unit/model/fixture/integration/UI/API/EVM simulation, syntax/type, build and package checks may run in GitHub Actions. Runtime and integration acceptance use the project-supported Linux configuration. Record exact source, configuration and run evidence. Deployment and live-chain acceptance require separate execution evidence.
Prevent funds/asset reentry and replay with authority and state preconditions.
Safely recover reorg, duplicate logs, RPC timeout and unknown results.
Restart and duplicate queue consumption preserve correlations and never duplicate settlement.
Associate errors with asset, transfer, request and run; publish sanitized error codes.
Keep secrets out of code, public artifacts, logs, chain and metadata; encrypted receipt-access storage is separate from wallet-key custody.
Explicit network, chain, contracts, units, confirmation and timeout parameters enter configuration digest.
Measure load, duration, backlog and failure rate; do not invent throughput/latency SLAs.
Product documentation is in English.

Trace reference-source timing and UI projections; do not expose wallet identities, private records, signing secrets or raw authorization material. Data failure and locale changes cannot rewrite signed content.
Upgrade, pause and recovery cannot bypass ownership or finalized-prefix boundaries.

Align whole-artwork backend receipt, wallet, Oracle, journal, freeze/release, rollback and audit semantics with actual contracts/schema/events/errors and evidence. Reuse first; no implied new deployment instance or migration permission.
Route REG-DIRECT, REG-ELECTRONIC and REG-INTERMEDIARY sources to the same trade/settlement backend; Oracle remains sole raw-voucher authority.

Implement usable frontend flows for all three source paths with source explanation, declared mint voucher format, task state and original Oracle records. Share immutable allowed-currency selection, matching, wallet authorization, ETH maximum/median disclosure and confirmation, shortage warnings/refusal, owner/holder, funds and history. No conversion or multi-currency sum. Placeholder buttons do not satisfy this requirement.
Alignment covers whole artwork/receipt only, excluding charity fractions, shares and invented market modes.

The settlement demonstration uses Ethereum Sepolia 11155111 and test ETH gas, with verified designated test PYUSD permitted by fixture NFT0 and explicitly selected by orders. Deferred cross-chain tests additionally lock Hoodi ETH on Hoodi 560048; Hoodi does not replace Sepolia settlement, its gas or principal. Do not copy unrelated Wallet configuration.
Deliver all six revised scenarios with actual steps, state assertions and execution evidence.
Deliver an operable trading demo, editable PPT proposal and playable film, clearly labelling real test-chain activity, simulated registrars and animation.

Deferred mode is optional and seller-consented, with an exact T+n deadline or 72 hours before the registration deadline; retain prepaid mode. Only NFT0-allowed USD stablecoins may be principal. EX grants secured trading allowance, not a cash loan, and charges no interest spread.

Accept BTC/ETH as product collateral; test only Hoodi ETH collateral with Sepolia PYUSD principal and Sepolia ETH gas. Hoodi operations need separately accounted Hoodi gas. No unimplemented Bitcoin custody or cross-chain bridge is inferred.

Verify canonical finalized collateral lock evidence and its chain, vault, asset, borrower, amount and unique identity before granting destination allowance. Authenticated proof validation, valuation freshness/denomination and explicit ratio policy are required; 50 percent is only an example.

Reserve collateral-backed allowance per obligation atomically and durably; reject duplicate pledges, replay, conflicting observations and concurrent over-allocation. A UI balance or caller verified flag is not authority.

For A-B-C, B may resell before paying A. C's principal enters B's escrow, with original refundable segment encumbrances preserved and no double allocation. B may deposit the correctly denominated difference before the agreed deadline.

If the settlement deadline arrives before AB registration completes, treat AB as incomplete and initiate the existing eligible rollback, preserving registered prefix. Do not extend the payment wait or pay A as if registration succeeded.

If AB registration completes first, its NFT rollback responsibility permanently detaches under the original ordered-cut rule even if A is unpaid. B independently owes A; later debt, liquidation or payment failure cannot reverse that completed cut or make C responsible.

Allow early manual settlement only with the original registration and authorization conditions. At registered-debt maturity, settle from available B escrow; liquidate pledged collateral for a remaining shortfall. No automatic unapproved margin-call threshold or guaranteed recovery is added.

When B cannot fund gas needed for eligible rollback, allow collateral liquidation to cover that verified gas shortfall. Keep debt principal, fee, Sepolia recovery gas, Hoodi execution gas and residual collateral separate; do not treat Hoodi ETH as Sepolia gas.

Liquidation request, source execution and destination receipt are distinct. Only verified destination PYUSD satisfies seller-payment funds; only verified destination ETH satisfies recovery-gas funding. Missing liquidity/provider, partial proceeds or unknown outcome remain unresolved, never fabricated conversion.

Persist operation identity, exact payload and reservation before dispatch; reconcile ambiguous outcomes without blind replay. Confirm actual payment/refund/release once, preserve restart/concurrency safety and prohibit collateral unlock while secured obligations or unknown effects remain.

Reuse existing UI rather than create a duplicate. Bind implementation, exact-head CI and main merge to the module contract before downstream wiring/testing/deployment acceptance. Report simulation, CI, actual cross-chain and served acceptance separately.

cases.assertion: One NFT is one whole receipt; preserve full receipt and underlying goods quantity; reject fractions and duplicate mappings.

Initial equality and subsequent independent positions are accurate. ownerOf is an address, not a position; currentEntry latest admission and holderAsOf historical effective holder are distinct; future effectiveAt is not current effectiveness.
Record A to B to C to D in order, with a separate registration request for every hop.

Sequential EX/Oracle registration remains contiguous and replayable without skipping or a second receipt. Protocol versions are contiguous and effectiveAt strictly increases; same-holder confirmation is valid. Version, transfer count and holderPosition never substitute for one another.
Consume the same Oracle record idempotently; reject different content under the same identity; no second business receipt.
Reject absent, expired, revoked or altered asset, amount or chain-domain authorization.
Reject nonce replay; concurrent transfers to two buyers advance only one valid head.
Account switching, disconnect or lost session must not reuse the previous account's authorization.
Independently submitted bids and asks follow price priority, equal-price FIFO and best executable price; no queue jumping, altered limits or specified-counterparty substitution.
All three Oracle adapters satisfy one registration contract using mint-declared formats; holder follows the same receipt; simulated roles are labelled.

Prepaid-mode regression: Principal uses the explicit selected member of the immutable NFT0 set through freeze/release/refund. Refuse missing/changed currency, conversion/substitution and insufficient/unknown selected-currency balance even with sufficient ETH gas. Freeze each liability separately before trade; no second principal debit after registration.
Release eligible AB without waiting for C or D.
Prepaid-mode regression: Keep every segment's price and funds separate; pending later funds cannot subsidize an earlier release.

Reject wrong asset/segment/journal/network/source and bind chain/token contract/tokenId/registerId/verificationProfile/authority to the remote finalized record. Any account may relay valid proof; caller allowlists and ordinary signatures do not replace proof verification.

Historical C and current D coexist correctly. Historical finality holds first.effectiveAt <= t < latest.effectiveAt; latest and later remain provisional. Earlier-than-first holderAsOf/entryAsOf revert and isFinalAsOf is false. Cancellation adds no finality; EX prefix completion is distinct.
Recover unknown RPC or execution results for release of already frozen funds idempotently; no new buyer-payment business failure, duplicate debit or gas charge.
When registration of B is refused and holder is A, refund the unregistered suffix and return owner to A; holder stays A and the NFT is not burned.
When AB is registered and registration of C is refused, withdraw BC/CD only and return owner to effective holder B; keep registration and settled AB; never reset to issuer.
Return each segment's unreleased principal to its original buyer; show actual gas and net proceeds with explicit units.
Intermediate wallets with zero ordinary ETH do not change recovery duties or require serial wallet-by-wallet NFT return.
One shared operation must not be charged in full to multiple segments.

ETH is the sole gas asset. Zero/insufficient/unverified applicable ETH warns and refuses new trading even if price funds suffice; selected-currency shortage also refuses. Original sufficient frozen gas remains usable for its approved recovery without second prepayment or double counting.

Resume crashed rollback without duplicate refunds/gas or revival of failed segments. cancelSettlement is not refund/owner return/registration reversal; enforce recorded initiator and strict protocol deadline independently. Gap closure cannot fabricate refusal or completion.
Honor mint time units and boundaries; refuse new trades after cutoff; overdue unregistered suffix fails and owner returns to effective holder; preserve registered and settled prefix.

EX transfers the bill of lading without physical collection, transport, warehouse exit or collection-driven burn. Terms remain readable; owner ahead of holder may resell. Authorized atomic holder remint is separately covered by T63-68.

Separate simulated/real, pending/complete, owner/holder, NONE/OPEN/ADMITTED/CANCELLED/SUPERSEDED, historical provisional/final, Oracle application refusal, admission and funds. No protocol REJECTED or overall-complete inference from NO/green.

Record exact source/config/run/commands/fixtures for GitHub Actions CI or the project-supported Linux configuration, as applicable. CI validates only checks actually run; it does not prove deployment or live-chain acceptance.
On duplicate consumption, restart or unknown freeze/release/refund, query before retry; never duplicate funds or gas actions.
Reject rollback without sufficient authority; no arbitrary confiscation or rewriting a finalized prefix.
Recover reorg, duplicate logs, RPC timeout and reordered events without early or repeated release.
Release and refund are mutually exclusive; reconcile segment principal, fees and final balances.

Trace bill-of-lading terms, original Oracle registration, holder and funds. Physical collection or collection-driven destruction is not completion; authorized remint separately preserves old/new NFT links and existing evidence.
Reject duplicate valid mappings, transfer replay and repeated funds actions; failed old segments stay dead, valid NFTs can start a new chain, history remains.
Agent actions already authorized in the wallet need no extra platform step approval; refuse out-of-scope actions.

Sepolia remains the execution/principal chain with verified NFT0-permitted selected PYUSD and test ETH gas. Reject accidental chain/asset substitution; allow Hoodi only for the separately specified deferred collateral source, never as settlement or gas replacement.
All six scenarios have matching actual transactions, simulated registration evidence, UI states and final assertions.
Demo, PPT and playable film consistently label real test-chain actions, simulated roles and animation; no implied institutional cooperation.
Required CI belongs to exact head; actual deployed commit matches; read back artifact bytes and hashes.
Verify that receipt-access secrets and wallet private keys are absent from product outputs, logs, chain data and NFT metadata; product documentation is in English.
Record real resource and performance baselines and diagnosable errors; no invented production SLA.
Mint complete asset-specific receipt data, terms, both cutoffs and time semantics; reject missing required fields; do not copy unrelated commodity rules.
Encrypt receipt-access secrets only in controlled off-chain storage; NFT has only opaque nonsecret mapping; no wallet private keys held by EX.
Before trade show both cap and median in ETH and contemporaneous USD with source, time, scope and buyer confirmation; unavailable quote, FX or confirmation blocks submission; no fake zero.
Rollback aligns owner only to effective holder; unexpired valid NFT may trade again, expired NFT stays closed; ordinary owner-ahead-of-holder resale remains allowed.

The voucher is the one receipt; Oracle alone ingests/verifies/writes it and holder follows it. No EX raw intake, independent holder writer, second receipt or late wait. Proof validates the accepted profile's remote finalized record, not legal title/source honesty/goods/payment; expectedHolder/initiator do not prove admitted holder.
Align ArtFi whole-artwork and EX backend receipt, authorization, Oracle, journal, freeze/release, rollback and audit contracts; provide difference map and shared regression evidence.

Direct, electronic and intermediary registration each has an operable UI and source route into one trading/settlement backend; verify route, Oracle, chain and UI together; placeholder buttons do not pass.
Backend and all sources retain whole artwork/receipt semantics; no charity fractions, shares or newly invented spot/futures/leverage modes.

Recompute P50 from real applicable algorithm, sample population/count/window/time and source; refuse fabricated or unrelated samples and single-point or cap-average substitutes; estimate is not a guarantee.

Buyer confirmation binds quote version, scope and cap; send/retry stays within it and wallet grant; exceeding or unprovable cap stops for fresh confirmation; splitting, retry or quote replacement cannot reset aggregate cap.

Freeze the confirmed maximum gas amount separately from principal before sending; insufficient or unknown freeze stops; debit actual consumption, unfreeze unused balance, keep failed-tx gas charged and process duplicates once.
Zero ETH warns and refuses a new trade despite sufficient NFT0 principal or other tokens; no transaction signing/broadcast, valid trade/registration task or owner advance. UI/API/Agent agree.

Check available ETH at zero, one wei below the maximum, exactly the maximum and above it, after other reservations. Sufficient P50 but insufficient cap refuses; sufficient funds proceed only when all other conditions hold.

Gas quote confirmation, freeze, debit and unused unfreeze settle in ETH; USD is display only. Refuse PYUSD/WETH/other gas assets, conversion, non-ETH-principal gas deductions and subsidy bypass. Preserve cap/median and consumption idempotence.

Recheck changed account/chain, concurrent ETH use, invalid freeze, old-signature replay and retries before signing/broadcast. Direct backend calls cannot bypass; prebroadcast refusal cannot invent consumed gas.

Sufficient original frozen ETH for the same approved rollback obligation remains usable with zero unfrozen cash. No second prepayment, early unfreeze or cancelled rollback. A remaining shortage uses the original confirmed replenishment flow in prepaid mode; deferred rollback may use the explicitly authorized collateral gas-recovery route in section 7.1.

Each order selects one immutable NFT0-allowed currency; both intents and leg freeze/release/refund match it. Wrong currency refuses consistently across three sources and UI/API/Agent, without conversion or substitution.

Absent, conflicting, changed or unverifiable NFT0 currencies or an order without explicit selection refuse. No ETH/PYUSD default or balance-based automatic choice. PYUSD fixtures require mint-time membership and explicit selection.

When selected principal is ETH, independently cover and account for principal and maximum gas. Refuse coverage of only one or counting the same balance/freeze twice. Reconcile principal refund and unused gas separately without restoring consumed gas.

Mint-time one-currency and multiple-currency sets are recorded/read correctly. No later UI/API/Agent/contract/admin path can add, remove or replace the same NFT set. Valid remint creates a new NFT while atomically burning the old one.

Prepaid-mode regression: Warn and refuse selected-currency principal at zero or one smallest unit short before signing/broadcast, despite sufficient other currencies/gas. Exact sufficiency may proceed under other conditions. Exclude concurrent reservations; reuse only this operation own effective freeze.

For multiple allowed currencies, both orders select the same currency; verify price priority/FIFO/best executable price independently inside each currency. No raw cross-currency numeric comparison, FX ranking, mixed principal sum or automatic conversion.

A holder possessing the original NFT with holder equal to owner may remint under valid existing wallet authority. Refuse non-holder, no possession, unequal owner, admin-only identity and invalid/revoked/replayed authority.
Successful remint atomically burns the old NFT and validly mints the new one. Failure of either leaves no one-sided asset loss or two simultaneously valid bills; retain same-operation evidence.

Before new mint holder may add/remove/change new terms including allowed currencies; preserve old terms/history. New minted currencies become immutable. New terms cannot bypass ETH gas, no-conversion, Oracle or authority boundaries.

Remint concurrent with trade/registration atomically rechecks possession and holder equal to owner, yielding one valid result. Duplicate/RPC-timeout/failed/UNKNOWN requests reconcile and recover idempotently, never repeating burn/mint/debit.

Read old/new NFT links both ways, term differences and original registration/trade/funds evidence. A burned predecessor cannot trade/remint again. New terms cannot delete or rewrite completed history.

Possession and holder equality establish the confirmed EX remint business predicate with existing authority; no cleanup/refund/unfreeze/migration approval. Address equality is not an ERC proof of no gap/escrow/tasks and cannot block ordinary owner-ahead-of-holder resale.

Market is an ordinary commodity spot-intermediary infrastructure DEMO with crypto/commodity styling, BTC/ETH and soybean/iron-ore scenes and simulation labels; no real financial or institutional endorsement.
Both crypto and warehouse NFTs are selectable collateral. Do not invent valuation/LTV/financing/liquidation/returns; undefined mechanisms affect only dependent actions while core spot work continues.

Continuously read/update actual external spot sources with traceable successful reads and source changes. Separate source/fetch times faithfully, preserving precision; static designs/manual values cannot pass actual integration.

Show provider/currency/unit/specification/market/priceType/as-of/fetch/delay. Reproduce stale/unavailable/parse failure/recovery honestly without fake zero, per-second-source claims or silent futures/unit substitution.

Each NFT has independent quote/status and correct click/keyboard/back/switch detail navigation. Only supported successful openGapOf nonzero/zero bytes32 maps to openGapOF=YES red/NO green. Unsupported/unknown/loading/error never maps to NO/green, another NFT's state or inferred positions.

Show all business conditions completely in an identity-excluding projection without summary or changed obligations. Keep unchanged complete private originals for hash/signature checks; never render identity-bearing originals or claim projection byte identity. Missing/placeholders fail completeness; locale explanation is informative.
Bind current/owner/holder independently to actual records on one timeline; 8/7/1 is a fixture. Cover equality, divergence, long chains and unknown values without hardcoded offsets or merged markers.

Every signature status binds its position/transfer, role, payload, applicable scheme version/domain/nonce or equivalent and verification. Distinguish unknown/unsigned/pending/signed and transaction/order/registration-proof/admission; never infer signing from alignment, chain length or proof success or move historic signatures to current owner.

No wallet names or full/truncated addresses across cards/details/terms/embeddings/popups/hover/title/accessibility/download/copy. Raw documents/JSON/metadata cannot leak identities. Backend originals/hash/signature/authority stay intact; add no identity permission prompt.
openGapOF=YES red and owner!=holder do not automatically block ordinary transfers. Independent deadline/principal/gas/authority reasons remain accurate; remint qualification remains separate.
Market makers and ordinary participants follow same-currency price/FIFO without identity priority, selected-counterparty bypass or default AMM/rebate/incentive/return promises.

All six candidate languages cover markets/cards/terms/timeline/unknown/errors/principal/gas without mixed language or clipping. Preserve protocol identifiers and exact openGapOF=YES/NO with YES red/NO green; unknown stays unknown and original signed language remains unchanged.
No wallet asset/account/security/validator/Agent-permission-management routes; per-trade authority, balance/freeze and gas confirmation remain enforced.

Separate external references, simulated NFT quotes/trades and real chain evidence. A per-tonne reference cannot replace whole-receipt price or trigger FX-based cross-currency matching/payment/gas conversion.

Documents/design/code/runtime have independent identities. v1.5 cannot inherit a historical loader pass or clickable design as runtime acceptance; preserve T-01..68, six stages/demos and the current product edition.

Responsive market/details navigation and loading/error/empty/long-chain states recover; all three sources share real states and six-language rules. Missing feed/original terms stays explicit, never overall-complete.

Deferred mode is optional and seller-consented, with an exact T+n deadline or 72 hours before the registration deadline; retain prepaid mode. Only NFT0-allowed USD stablecoins may be principal. EX grants secured trading allowance, not a cash loan, and charges no interest spread.

Accept BTC/ETH as product collateral; test only Hoodi ETH collateral with Sepolia PYUSD principal and Sepolia ETH gas. Hoodi operations need separately accounted Hoodi gas. No unimplemented Bitcoin custody or cross-chain bridge is inferred.

Verify canonical finalized collateral lock evidence and its chain, vault, asset, borrower, amount and unique identity before granting destination allowance. Authenticated proof validation, valuation freshness/denomination and explicit ratio policy are required; 50 percent is only an example.

Reserve collateral-backed allowance per obligation atomically and durably; reject duplicate pledges, replay, conflicting observations and concurrent over-allocation. A UI balance or caller verified flag is not authority.

For A-B-C, B may resell before paying A. C's principal enters B's escrow, with original refundable segment encumbrances preserved and no double allocation. B may deposit the correctly denominated difference before the agreed deadline.

If the settlement deadline arrives before AB registration completes, treat AB as incomplete and initiate the existing eligible rollback, preserving registered prefix. Do not extend the payment wait or pay A as if registration succeeded.

If AB registration completes first, its NFT rollback responsibility permanently detaches under the original ordered-cut rule even if A is unpaid. B independently owes A; later debt, liquidation or payment failure cannot reverse that completed cut or make C responsible.

Allow early manual settlement only with the original registration and authorization conditions. At registered-debt maturity, settle from available B escrow; liquidate pledged collateral for a remaining shortfall. No automatic unapproved margin-call threshold or guaranteed recovery is added.

When B cannot fund gas needed for eligible rollback, allow collateral liquidation to cover that verified gas shortfall. Keep debt principal, fee, Sepolia recovery gas, Hoodi execution gas and residual collateral separate; do not treat Hoodi ETH as Sepolia gas.

Liquidation request, source execution and destination receipt are distinct. Only verified destination PYUSD satisfies seller-payment funds; only verified destination ETH satisfies recovery-gas funding. Missing liquidity/provider, partial proceeds or unknown outcome remain unresolved, never fabricated conversion.

Persist operation identity, exact payload and reservation before dispatch; reconcile ambiguous outcomes without blind replay. Confirm actual payment/refund/release once, preserve restart/concurrency safety and prohibit collateral unlock while secured obligations or unknown effects remain.

Reuse existing UI rather than create a duplicate. Bind implementation, exact-head CI and main merge to the module contract before downstream wiring/testing/deployment acceptance. Report simulation, CI, actual cross-chain and served acceptance separately.

stages.title: Baseline and evidence alignment
stages.entry: Verify current source, CI evidence and Linux execution configuration; separate bootstrap, fixtures, application and deployment.
actions: Resolve full branch/commit/tree and actual diff.
Inventory existing wallet, orders, Oracle, journal, settlement and UI reuse interfaces and precise missing bindings.
Map ArtFi whole-artwork contracts, the three source middleware routes and their actual frontend entrypoints.
Trace requirement to test to exact source to run to artifact.
stages.deliverables: Baseline identity, interface map, requirement/test map and current PRD pin.
stages.acceptance: Independent source/evidence identity; no assertion that CI means product acceptance.

stages.title: Domain state and basic interaction
stages.entry: Use verified source and supported Linux configuration; label fixtures wherever a real integration is absent.
actions: Implement complete mint declaration, whole NFT, encrypted off-chain mapping, both deadlines and voucher format; ordered owner/holder positions.
Independent bids/asks; price/FIFO/best-price matching and replayable trusted book sequence.
Disclose cap/P50 ETH/USD with statistical evidence; buyer confirmation; separate principal and maximum gas freezes before send.
Read actual wallet grant and show switch/disconnect/revocation/session loss without extra Agent approval.
Three Oracle sources share a contract; holder follows the same authoritative record; ordered index rebuild and duplicate handling.
Operable basic UI and whole-artwork backend alignment; separate actual, simulated and disconnected states.
stages.deliverables: Domain model, samples, adapter contracts, operable UI and Linux unit/state evidence.
stages.acceptance: All applicable Stage 1 cases including T-41..43,45..51; real freeze is never inferred from model.

stages.title: Segment principal and independent settlement
stages.entry: Reproducible chain and registration sequence; real paths additionally require actual authority.
actions: Freeze each buyer's own segment principal and confirmed maximum gas separately in wallet; bind parties, asset, amount and Oracle reference.
Never use unreleased later funds to support earlier settlement or resale.
Release original frozen funds once owner/holder positions and timely Oracle registration make the segment eligible; eliminate its return control.
Demonstrate AB release while BC/CD remain pending; bind original Oracle/journal/settlement coordinator.
Recover unknown release, RPC failure, repeat events and restart by lookup before retry; no new buyer payment or business-payment failure.
stages.deliverables: Segment escrow/settlement implementation, real/simulated binding list, reconciliation and Linux unit/integration evidence.
stages.acceptance: T-11..16,28,31 and applicable T-51; per-segment reconciliation; historical C/current D interpreted correctly.

stages.title: Suffix rollback and buyer gas
stages.entry: Segment model is verified; genuine rollback needs existing authorized control and test gas path.
actions: If registration of B is refused with holder A, unwind the unregistered suffix; after registered AB, if registration of C is refused, unwind BC/CD only and return owner to holder B.
Keep registered segments even while technical release is recovering; never revoke holder or reset issuer.
Refund original buyers; actual gas and net amounts use separate explicit assets and units.
Return NFT without intermediate-wallet traversal or reliance on ordinary wallet ETH; no duplicate full shared-operation charging.
Recover interruption, retries, obsolete/duplicate events, insufficient budget and unknown results; do not invent late-receipt waits.
Re-trade valid unexpired assets from recovered owner=holder; ordinary resale still permits owner ahead of holder.
Integrate gas statistical disclosure, confirmation/cap, maximum prefreeze, actual debit, unused unfreeze and reconfirmed top-up; D-04 allocation only remains pending.
No gas-shortage custody, redemption deadline, forced sale or liquidation.
stages.deliverables: Rollback, fee/reconciliation records, recovery flow and Linux fault-injection evidence.
stages.acceptance: Applicable T-17..23,29,30,43,44,49..51; model evidence and real control/fee evidence remain distinct.

stages.title: Deadline, bill transfer, restored trading and holder remint
stages.entry: Reproducible trading, Oracle and rollback; verifiable mint cutoffs/formats. No physical-collection or collection-driven-burn gate; authorized holder remint remains required.
actions: Reject new trades at cutoff and verify mint units, timezone, precision and serialized boundary semantics.
Overdue unregistered suffix fails; return only owner to current holder; preserve registration, issuer and settled prefix.
Resolve registration/deadline races against one authoritative ordered state; no holder-first/receipt-later, second receipt or grace stage.
Valid unexpired unburned NFT may begin a new chain when authorized; expiry cannot be bypassed by recovery.
Allow ordinary owner-ahead-of-holder continuous resale.
Show full bill terms, off-chain collection obligations and Oracle/transfer history without implementing physical fulfillment or collection-driven destruction.
Reject duplicate mapping and transfer replay; preserve history and idempotent technical recovery.
stages.deliverables: Deadline and suffix recovery model, bill-transfer/scope UI, boundary fixtures and resumed-trading evidence.
stages.acceptance: T-24,25,32,33,44,45; only applicable branch evidence; no out-of-scope fulfillment in completion.

stages.title: Sepolia integration and final delivery
stages.entry: Affected model/integration checks and exact runtime configuration, permissions, asset control and designated test asset are verified for each real path.
actions: Deploy exact candidate using project-supported Linux process; absent target blocks that deployment only while packaging proceeds.
Execute six revised scenarios on Sepolia 11155111 with actual chain records and explicitly simulated registrars, never Hoodi substitution.
Cover all three source/Oracle contracts and record each scenario's chosen main source.
Verify whole-artwork backend alignment, each middleware route and frontend; join actual Oracle, funds and UI evidence.
Generate demo, editable PPT and playable film from final verified demo; distinguish real chain, simulated institutional roles and animation.
Independently verify exact head CI, same-version artifact and actually served version; package identity is not deployment evidence.
stages.deliverables: Accessible demo, deployment receipt, six scenario results, three-source coverage, tests/security results, PPT, film and remaining issues.
stages.acceptance: All six scenarios and complete evidence chain; deployment/runtime/chain/product verdicts separate; NOT_RUN for absent operations.

decisions.blocks: Only unresolved actual schema, serialization or controlled-store bindings.

decisions.rule: Overdue unregistered suffix fails at cutoff; return owner to effective holder and preserve prefix; no late-receipt grace.
decisions.blocks: Verify actual time, Oracle ordering and concurrency boundaries; not a new product choice.

decisions.rule: Cap/P50 ETH and contemporaneous USD, confirmation, cap-sized freeze, actual debit and unused unfreeze are fixed.
decisions.blocks: Only allocation of one genuinely shared operation remains a product decision; actual send/payment interfaces require engineering verification.

decisions.rule: Real owner return uses existing authorized asset control and wallet grant.
decisions.blocks: Only actual rollback lacking verified authority or interface; models and settled business rules proceed.

decisions.rule: Prepaid mode freezes principal before trade and registration releases that position without a second payment. The separately selected deferred mode follows section 7.1: collateral allowance, registration-independent B debt, exact deadline and recovery rules.
decisions.blocks: Implementation and exact-version acceptance remain; no EX lending obligation is added.

decisions.rule: Physical fulfillment remains outside EX; holder possession/equality, authorized atomic remint and new terms are in scope without additional cleanup/migration decisions.
decisions.blocks: No physical-delivery gate; implement confirmed remint.

Crypto and warehouse-NFT choices remain. Section 7.1 confirms optional BTC/ETH-backed deferred stablecoin settlement, deadline debt liquidation and rollback-gas recovery, without EX lending. Exact ratio, valuation/finality/provider and fee parameters must be explicitly configured; no invented defaults or returns.

demonstrations.title: Single bill-of-lading transfer
demonstrations.setup: A to B; Oracle writes the verified registration voucher and holder reaches B.
demonstrations.expected: Release original frozen AB funds; owner=holder=B; readable bill and registration history; no physical collection or collection-driven burn.

demonstrations.title: Continuous trading and prefix release
demonstrations.setup: A to B to C to D, holder advances contiguously.
demonstrations.expected: Release AB first without waiting for D; then independently BC and CD.

demonstrations.title: Registration of B is refused
demonstrations.setup: Owner D, holder A; B registration refused.
demonstrations.expected: Unwind only unregistered AB/BC/CD, owner returns to A, original buyers refunded, actual fees separate and charged once.

demonstrations.title: Refused registration of C preserves AB
demonstrations.setup: AB registered and settled; owner D, holder B; registration of C is refused.
demonstrations.expected: Unwind BC/CD, owner returns to B; preserve AB registration and released principal; no issuer reset.

demonstrations.title: Intermediate ordinary-wallet ETH shortage
demonstrations.setup: Intermediate ordinary wallets lack ETH and recovery is needed.
demonstrations.expected: Prearranged authorized return remains possible; each buyer bears applicable gas; no temporary custody or forced sale.

demonstrations.title: Cutoff failure and recovery boundary
demonstrations.setup: At trade cutoff attempt a new transfer with unregistered segments outstanding.
demonstrations.expected: Reject new trade; overdue unregistered suffix fails and owner returns to effective holder; keep registered/settled prefix; no expired reopening or collection-driven burn.

retiredRequirements.requirement: EX physical collection, transport, warehouse exit, voucher handover or collection-driven burn
Late registration grace, holder changed before its receipt or EX second business receipt
A second buyer payment or buyer business-payment failure after registration
Permanent closing of a still-valid unexpired NFT after suffix rollback, or issuer reset
Treating price priority/FIFO/best executable price as undecided or specified pairing as its substitute
Treating cap/P50, buyer confirmation, freeze/debit/unfreeze as undecided; fake median; cap reset on retry
Gas-shortage custody, timed redemption, forced sale or liquidation
EX raw registration-voucher intake, verification or independent holder writer
Fractional warehouse receipts or mixing charity shares into whole-artwork alignment
